title: Pure White Aura
summary: Ren's White Aura archetype is a WATER Fish Synchro strategy where every Synchro Monster (White Aura Whale, Bihamut, Monoceros, Porpoise, and Dolphin) banishes a WATER monster from your GY when destroyed by your opponent to revive itself AND treat itself as a Tuner! With the Phantom Nightmare support (White Sardine, White Sunfish, White Reincarnation, and White Aura Porpoise), activate White Reincarnation to search White Sardine, send a second White Sardine from your Deck to the GY to Special Summon the first from your hand, and then revive that second copy with White Mirror (which also searches a third copy!). Every Fish revived from your GY can be treated as a Tuner, letting you climb through Level 6 White Aura Porpoise and Level 7 White Aura Monoceros into the 3300 ATK double-token boss White Aura Bihamut and the board-wiping White Aura Whale!

allow.One for One: Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Level 1 Beautunaful Princess from your Deck to pull any White Fish.
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends White Sardine or White Sunfish to the GY to be revived as a Tuner via White Mirror or White Aura Porpoise.

allow.Marincess Coral Anemone: Link-2 WATER monster that revives White Sardine, White Sunfish, or White Stingray from your GY.
allow.Arionpos, Serpent of the Ghoti: Level 6 Fish Synchro bridge that banishes Fish monsters from Deck to trigger Ghoti combos.

main: White Sardine

Core Level 2 WATER Fish (Phantom Nightmare): sends 1 'White Sardine' from your Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself from your hand (locking Extra Deck to WATER monsters for the turn); and if Special Summoned from the GY (by White Mirror, White Sunfish, Porpoise, or Monoceros!), you can treat this card as a Tuner this turn!
White Sunfish

Core Level 4 WATER Fish (Phantom Nightmare): if this card is in your hand, targets 1 Level 4 or lower Fish monster in your GY (like the White Sardine you dumped!) to Special Summon itself and Special Summon that target; and if Special Summoned from the GY, you can treat this card as a Tuner this turn!
White Stingray
Core Level 4 WATER Fish: discards 1 WATER monster to Special Summon itself from your hand; and if Special Summoned from the GY, this card is treated as a Tuner this turn!
White Moray

Level 2 WATER Fish: can attack directly the turn it was Normal Summoned; and if Special Summoned from the GY (by White Mirror, White Sunfish, Porpoise, or Coral Anemone), can be treated as a Tuner this turn!
Beautunaful Princess
Level 1 WATER Fish starter: banishes itself when Normal or Special Summoned to Special Summon White Sardine, White Sunfish, or White Stingray directly from your Deck!
White Reincarnation

Core Continuous Spell (Phantom Nightmare): when activated, adds ANY Fish monster with a 'White' effect that treats itself as a Tuner (White Sardine, White Sunfish, or White Stingray!) from your Deck to your hand; once per turn when your 'White Aura' monster attacks, forces your opponent to take another effect: either revive a monster from your GY OR inflict 1500 burn damage if a Level 8+ Synchro was revived from the GY!
White Mirror

Core Normal Spell: targets 1 Level 4 or lower Fish monster in your GY (White Sardine, White Sunfish, or White Stingray!) and Special Summons it (immediately turning it into a Tuner!), THEN adds 1 monster from your Deck to your hand with the same original name as that Special Summoned monster!
White Howling
Normal Trap: while you control a WATER monster, targets 1 Spell in your opponent's GY, banishes it, and for the rest of this turn, negates all Spell effects on your opponent's field!
One for One
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Beautunaful Princess from your Deck.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends White Sardine or White Sunfish to the GY to be revived by White Sunfish or White Mirror.
extra: Signature Level 8 WATER Fish Synchro boss (1 WATER Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner WATER monsters; 2800 ATK): when Synchro Summoned, destroys ALL Attack Position monsters your opponent controls; can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase; inflicts piercing battle damage; and if destroyed by your opponent and sent to the GY, banishes 1 other WATER monster from your GY to Special Summon itself AND treat itself as a Tuner (not once per turn!)!

Signature Level 10 WATER Fish Synchro boss (1 Tuner Synchro Monster + 1+ non-Tuner monsters: Level 6 White Aura Porpoise [treated as a Tuner!] + Level 4 White Sunfish/Stingray, or Level 8 Whale [revived as a Tuner!] + Level 2 Sardine; 3300 ATK): once per turn during your turn, when Synchro Summoned or while you control no Tokens, Special Summons a 3300 ATK / 3000 DEF 'Divine Dragon Token' during either player's turn; and banishes the Token to revive itself as a Tuner if destroyed!

Core Level 6 WATER Fish Synchro (Phantom Nightmare; 1 WATER Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners: Level 2 White Sardine + Level 4 White Sunfish/Stingray): when Synchro Summoned, Special Summons 1 Level 4 or lower Fish monster from your hand or GY, then you can Special Summon 1 monster with that same name from your GY; and revives itself from the GY as a Tuner by banishing a WATER monster if destroyed by your opponent!

Signature Level 7 WATER Fish Synchro (1 WATER Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners; 2500 ATK): when Synchro Summoned, targets 1 Fish monster in your GY (including Level 6 White Aura Porpoise or Level 8 White Aura Whale!) and Special Summons it; and banishes a WATER monster from GY if destroyed by your opponent to revive itself as a Tuner!

Level 6 WATER Fish Synchro (2400 ATK): once per turn targets 1 face-up monster your opponent controls to halve its original ATK until the end of this turn; and banishes a WATER monster from GY if destroyed by your opponent to revive itself as a Tuner!
Level 10 WATER Synchro boss (accessible under White Sardine's WATER lock!) that banishes cards from the opponent's field and GY whenever a card is banished.
Link-2 WATER monster that revives White Sardine or White Sunfish from your GY (which immediately turns them into Tuners!).
Level 6 Synchro: banishes a Level 6 or lower Fish from Deck on summon; banishes Fish from GY on Synchro material.
